DemoBeacon.Title: Demo Beacon
DemoBeacon.Description: Harmless lifecycle demonstration used during foundation development. It records local diagnostics only.

ControlCenter.Title: GameAssist Control Center
ControlCenter.Hint: Inspect GameAssist health, features, and capabilities. GM only.
ControlCenter.Denied: GameAssist Control Center is available to GMs only.
ControlCenter.Help: GameAssist reports unknown capabilities instead of guessing. Disable a feature here if you do not want it to start.

Recovery.WaitReady: Wait for the world to finish loading, then reopen Control Center.
Recovery.Reload: Reload the world to start GameAssist again.
Recovery.RetryFeature: A feature failed to start. Disable it, or reload the world to retry.
Recovery.CheckSystem: This world is not the locked Foundry or dnd5e baseline. Unrelated features may still run.
